rationale.consistency: Code aligns perfectly with Zoekt conventions, utilizing the standard flag package, tabwriter, and idiomatic error handling.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles repository detection, duplicates, and missing shards safely, but misses the requirement to print usage (only fails) when run without positional roots.
rationale.scope: Implements all requested functionality including default dry-run, locking, discovery, and name preservation without unnecessary additions.
rationale.readability: Clean, logical separation of concerns across multiple files (discover.go, inventory.go, lock.go) with expressive variable names.
rationale.robustness: Safely acquires non-blocking file locks, properly handles missing index states in IsUpToDate, and reliably defers resource cleanup.
rationale.maintainability: Highly extensible subcommand routing and a clean refactoring of gitindex prepare logic makes future modifications straightforward.
